title: Vintage 1963 Orange State Titans Wool & Leather Varsity Jacket
description: A true 1960s collegiate letterman: royal blue wool body, cream leather sleeves, big orange felt "OS" chenille patch and "Orange State Titans College '63" embroidery. Striped knit collar, cuffs and waistband and snap-front closure. Cream leather shows honest wear with some scuffing and light discoloration on the sleeves and cuffs, which adds to the vintage character.

facts.color: royal blue with cream sleeves and orange accents
flaws: scuffing and light staining on the cream leather sleeves
possible light wear at the pockets
highlights: wool body with genuine leather sleeves
striped knit collar, cuffs and waistband
no obvious holes in the wool

title: Polaroid Supercolor 1000 Land Camera with Flash Bar
description: A classic Polaroid Supercolor 1000 Land Camera with the iconic rainbow stripe, red shutter button and a flash bar attached. The white and black body looks clean and well kept, with no cracks or missing pieces visible. A fun, collectible piece for instant-film fans and vintage camera shelves.

highlights: Clean white body, no cracks seen

title: Vintage Tan Leather Tall Riding Boots, Well-Worn
description: Tall pull-on boots in rich honey-tan leather that has picked up a lovely patina over the years. The shaft is soft and slouchy, with a stacked heel and a leather sole that has seen real wear. These are honestly broken-in boots with plenty of character, and they'd look great with jeans or a skirt.

flaws: heavy wear and scuffing on the leather soles
darkened, stained patches on the leather shaft
creasing and wrinkling at the ankle and shaft
highlights: soft honey-tan leather with a rich patina

title: Vintage Teal & Amber Ombré Plaid Wool Shirt Jacket
description: A cozy shirt-jacket in a bold teal, amber and slate ombré plaid, with gold snap buttons, two roomy patch pockets and a curved hem. The fabric is soft and brushed, and the cuffs turn back for an easy layered look. It's in good vintage condition with no holes or stains that I could see.

highlights: bold teal, amber and slate ombré plaid

title: Beacon II 127 Film Camera with Flash, Whitehouse c.1947
description: A handsome black Beacon II box camera by Whitehouse Products, made in the late 1940s. It comes with its chrome faceted reflector flash attachment, which gives it a lot of mid-century charm. The body looks clean with bright chrome trim and crisp textured finish. A great display piece for any camera or vintage collector.

facts.material: molded plastic body with chrome trim
flaws: light surface scratches visible on the flash reflector
highlights: Beacon II model with the flash unit attached

title: Madhubani Print Tussar Silk Stole with Fringe
description: A beautiful hand-feel silk stole printed with traditional Madhubani folk art: a parade of elephants, musicians and dancers in teal, crimson, mustard and red on a natural oatmeal ground. Finished with soft, hand-knotted fringe at the ends. Warm, earthy and full of detail, it works as a wrap, scarf or wall hanging.

facts.color: natural beige with teal, red and mustard
flaws: Fringe looks slightly uneven and a little loose or frayed at the edge
Only one close-up was seen, so the rest of the piece is unchecked
highlights: Traditional Madhubani elephant and figure motifs
Rich teal, crimson and mustard palette

title: Poedagar Men's Blue Dial Quartz Watch, Leather Strap
description: A bold fashion watch with a deep sunburst blue dial, silver and copper-toned faceted bezel, and luminous hands. It has a black croc-embossed leather strap and a quartz movement. It's a good everyday dress watch with plenty of colour. The case and strap look to be in good shape.

facts.material: Metal alloy case with leather strap
flaws: Bezel shows some tonal variation and wear that could be patina or the finish
Strap has not been checked up close for creasing
highlights: Deep sunburst blue dial with crystal-style hour markers

title: Silver Mirrored Aviator Sunglasses, Blue-Green Lens
description: Classic teardrop aviators with a slim silver metal frame and blue-green mirrored lenses that flash purple and green in the light. Comfortable nose pads and sturdy hinges. They are a good everyday pair or a throwback accessory. The lenses and frame look clean in our check.

flaws: Only one angle seen, so the lens coating and the inside of the frame are unchecked
highlights: Nose pads and temple tips are intact
No obvious scratches or bent parts visible
